title: Unraveling the Interconnected Axes of Heterogeneity in Machine Learning for Democratic and Inclusive Advancements

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and literature review discussing annotation mismatches and Eurocentric bias in datasets, such as inconsistent labeling of non-Western images (e.g., brides and grooms from Ethiopia and Pakistan) based on annotator backgrounds.

Conceptual discussion and literature review examining how the use of proxies (e.g., zip codes or healthcare costs) inadvertently encodes and perpetuates historical racial disparities in algorithmic decision-making.

Theoretical evaluation of how resource heterogeneity, including compute costs, data availability, and expertise gaps, leads to the exclusion and misrepresentation of smaller, marginalized, or under-resourced communities in ML pipelines.
